title: Ordinary supported-source cone normalization
statement: Fix l prime, Y a scheme, D an ordinary strict reduction presentation for diagonalScalarExtension, and s:F(diagonalCompletedSource(l,Y))≅lim(D.E(diagonalIntegralSource(Y))). SupportedSourceConeNormalization means that for each n the completed integral generator followed by forgetting(s.hom≫limit.projection(n)) equals the scalar-adjunction unit followed by forgetting(D.projection(n)). This is exactly the source-generator clause in IsDiagonalLimit, named without alteration.

def SupportedSourceConeNormalization (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (D : DiagonalReductionPresentation l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (s : (diagonalCompletedRestriction l (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
      (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) ≅ limit (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y))) : Prop
